# wgpu

> Pure Go implementation of the W3C WebGPU API, with zero CGO. One Go API over three build-tag-selected stacks:
> the default Pure Go stack (Vulkan, Metal, DirectX 12, OpenGL ES and a CPU software backend), `-tags rust`
> (wgpu-native through go-webgpu/webgpu), and `js,wasm` (the browser's WebGPU). Shaders are WGSL, compiled by
> gogpu/naga to SPIR-V, MSL, HLSL, DXIL or GLSL. Validation and resource state tracking follow Rust wgpu-core.
> Render and compute pipelines, GPU-to-CPU readback, render bundles, queries and damage-aware presentation are
> included. Ray queries are not usable yet: HAL code only, no public API, not run on a GPU.
> Runs on Windows, Linux, macOS and in browsers (WASM); Android/arm64 Vulkan is a preview. Go 1.25+.
> Pre-1.0: the API may change before v1.0.

- [API Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/wgpu)
- [README](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/blob/main/README.md): overview, backends, installation
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents using wgpu
- [ARCHITECTURE](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): core, HAL and backends
- [Compute shaders](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/blob/main/docs/COMPUTE-SHADERS.md): compute pipelines and readback
- [Surface targets](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/blob/main/docs/SURFACE-TARGETS.md): presenting to windows
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): changes and known issues per release
- [ROADMAP](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): plan to v1.0
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute

## Examples

- [examples](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/tree/main/examples): all examples
- [triangle-headless](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/tree/main/examples/triangle-headless): render without a window
- [compute-sum](https://github.com/gogpu/wgpu/tree/main/examples/compute-sum): compute shader with readback
